config.exposure: chosen agent is the one whose failure region contains the task
config.pairing: same task stream and per-task outcome uniforms (common random numbers) and same selection RNG draw count in all arms; task streams are also identical across scenarios for a seed
config.repeat_failure: task falls in a failure region of the chosen agent, fails, and the same (mode) failed earlier in the run

scenarios.scenario: A: failures in latent sub-clusters (router blind)
B: failures aligned with a router-visible feature

config.bytes: estimated via bytes() (tight allocation), incl. 88 B/item stats overhead for tiered; flat-all pre-sized
config.relevance: query = noisy copy of a group centroid; relevant = the 10 members of that group; recall = hits/10
